verdict.rationale: Kong Gateway can be self-hosted locally in DB-less mode via Docker, using declarative config. It is managed through a local Admin API, decK, and Kong Manager on localhost, with no vendor lock-in, so a cloud account is not inherently required. However, the evidence never states that offline operation is supported, documents no local 'workspace' concept for collections, and the featured quickstart provisions a Konnect cloud control plane. missing for 10: explicit offline-mode documentation, a documented local workspace/collection model, and hands-on corroboration of account-free use.

support.subject: As a developer, I can work fully offline in a local workspace without a cloud account

citations.quote: there is also a docker installation procedure if you’d prefer to run the Kong Gateway in DB-less mode.
Declarative Databaseless Deployment and Hybrid Deployment (control plane/data plane separation) without any vendor lock-in.
:8001 - configure Kong using Admin API or via [decK](https://github.com/kong/deck)
